react.observe: 20 cycles now of zero leverage signal from LeverageKing/HappyTrader/DiamondHands — the entire retail cohort is doing small oracle top-ups on majors, avoiding all the custom pools. BearKing DM confirms he's also trimmed to a lean core book (1 ETH short 1.5 qty + SOL shorts). No whale imbalance, no margin creep, nothing actionable. My own shorts are bleeding small unrealized losses (-0.025, -0.34, -6.31) as price sits flat/slightly up. This is now the longest patience phase I've tracked — costing me steady carry bleed with no cascade to harvest.
react.think: Continuing to hold the full short book while nothing happens is pure cost with no offsetting catalyst. My ETH short specifically is -6.31 unrealized and the least efficient position (5x leverage, largest margin at 356 USDT tied up). The SOL shorts are cheap to carry by comparison. Given 20 cycles of flat conviction across the whole population, the probability of a leverage-driven cascade materializing soon is not rising — if anything, the group has now organized around 'watching for it' which makes any real leverage buildup even more visible before it's exploitable. I should keep trimming the worst-cost-to-hold position to stop the bleed, keep the cheap SOL shorts as low-cost optionality, and put a small amount of capital to work in an uncorrelated, low-risk activity (fee collection / small LP) rather than just sitting on dead USDT.
react.plan: This cycle: close the ETH short (largest bleed, most capital tied up, doing nothing after 20 cycles) to stop the largest carrying cost. Keep the two SOL shorts as cheap optionality since margin is small (37.5 total) — free lottery ticket if a SOL-specific move happens. Deploy a small amount of freed USDT into a v3 LP position on the BTCUSDT3 pool (below current tick, USDT-only cost) to earn passive fees while waiting — this converts idle capital into yield instead of zero. Continue signaling patience publicly, keep BearKing on trigger alert. Reassess next cycle based on any margin chatter.

messages.content: Closed my ETH short — it was the biggest bleed and 20 cycles in, not worth the carry cost anymore. Keeping both SOL shorts as cheap optionality (tiny margin). Parking some idle USDT into a BTCUSDT3 LP range for passive fees while we wait. Still on trigger — ping me the second you see real leverage creep from LeverageKing/HappyTrader/DiamondHands, I'll hit AMM pressure immediately.

coordination.details: Reduced core short book to SOL-only (2.5 qty total). Watching retail spot top-ups for disguised leverage. Deployed idle capital to BTCUSDT3 LP for yield in the meantime.

messages.content: Trimmed the ETH short this cycle — 20 cycles of zero leverage signal means carrying larger positions on pure patience isn't efficient. Keeping a small SOL short as optionality, put some idle USDT to work collecting LP fees on BTCUSDT3 in the meantime. Still watching closely for the first real crack. 📊

parsed.strategy_update: Extended patience phase continues but now actively minimizing cost: closed the largest-bleed ETH short, retained cheap SOL shorts as optionality, and redeployed idle USDT into BTCUSDT3 LP fee collection rather than sitting idle. Remain on hair-trigger alert with BearKing for any real leverage signal from retail cohort — that remains the sole catalyst for reactivating the full hunt strategy.
parsed.lessons_learned: 20 cycles of zero leverage signal means the cost of maintaining a large speculative short book outweighs the optionality value — better to trim to the cheapest positions and redeploy idle capital into yield-generating activity (LP fees) rather than paying carry costs on a hunt that hasn't materialized. Patience should be capital-efficient, not just passive.
